dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam! How's your internship? What are you working on?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm! ˈhaʊz jʊr ˈɪntɜːrnʃɪp? ˈwʌt ər juː ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈɑːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A new project. We're making a video about Thai islands.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈnuː ˈprɑːdʒɛkt. wɪr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˈvɪdioʊ əˈbaʊt ˈtaɪ ˈaɪləndz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sounds fun! Who are you working with?
dialogue.reading: ˈsaʊndz ˈfʌn! ˈhuː ər juː ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈwɪð?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three colleagues. Kate is our team leader.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈkɑːliːɡz. ˈkeɪt ɪz aʊr ˈtiːm ˌliːdər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For tourists from Europe and America.
dialogue.reading: fər ˈtʊrɪsts frəm ˈjʊrəp ənd əˈmɛrɪkə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. Today I had to deal with an angry customer on the phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. təˈdeɪ aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈdiːl wɪð ən ˈæŋɡri ˈkʌstəmər ɑːn ðə ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh no! What was he angry about?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt wʌz hiː ˈæŋɡri əˈbaʊt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: His hotel room. But Kate helped me. We have great teamwork!
dialogue.reading: hɪz hoʊˈtɛl ˈruːm. bʌt ˈkeɪt ˈhɛlpt miː. wiː ˈhæv ˈɡreɪt ˈtiːmwɜːrk!
